clusters.headline: Kennedy Center votes to restore Trump name to building facade

members.title: Kennedy Center aprova volta do nome de Trump à fachada apesar de decisão judicial

clusters.summary: The Kennedy Center's board approved the reinstatement of Trump's name on the building's exterior, proceeding with the decision despite a judicial ruling that had addressed the matter. The action represents a reversal of the center's earlier removal of the Trump name from the facade.

clusters.headline: Trump says he would declare Strait of Hormuz U.S. territory

members.title: Trump diz que vai declarar Estreito de Ormuz como território dos EUA
Trump threatens to declare strait of Hormuz ‘territory of the United States’

clusters.summary: Former President Donald Trump has stated his intention to declare the Strait of Hormuz as U.S. territory. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical waterway through which significant global oil shipments pass, making it strategically important to international commerce and geopolitics. This statement represents a significant territorial claim regarding one of the world's most important maritime chokepoints.
